notes: Gold content specs for the EOP2 briefing document. Used by the LLM workstream to evaluate the ContentSpecGenerator. Each gold section lists the claims a high-quality spec is expected to contain.

expected_claims: Aleniglipron is a GLP-1 receptor agonist under investigation for obesity.
Obesity represents a substantial unmet medical need with significant disease burden.
The nonclinical program supports continued clinical development.
The primary endpoint, percent change from baseline in body weight at Week 36, was met with statistical significance.
Key secondary endpoints including >=5% weight loss responder analysis were supportive.
The safety and tolerability profile was consistent with the GLP-1 class.
Phase 3 (ACCESS III) will use a randomized double-blind placebo-controlled parallel-group design.
Sample size justification will be provided with power calculation parameters.
An off-treatment follow-up period will characterise weight regain.
An independent MACE adjudication committee will be established.
Heart rate and blood pressure will be monitored with pre-specified stopping rules.
The plan references the 2022 agency correspondence on GLP-1 CV safety.
Does the FDA agree with the proposed Phase 3 primary endpoint and timepoint?
Does the FDA agree the proposed CV safety monitoring plan is adequate?
Does the FDA agree with the proposed Phase 3 sample size and follow-up duration?
